# Stally Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 12, 2026

Stally keeps a collection of the things you choose, care for, and spend time
with. This policy explains what data Stally handles, why it is handled, and the
choices available to you.

## Data Stally Handles

Stally stores the information you enter, including item names, notes, links,
tags, photos and captions, recording preferences, archive and favorite status,
Marks, and periods with the dates or date precision you supply.

Photos you select are copied into Stally. A saved attachment can retain
embedded information, including shooting dates and location when present.
Stally may resize or convert a photo to meet its storage limits. Editing or
deleting the attachment does not edit the source photo in your photo library.

## On-Device Storage and iCloud

Stally stores your collection on your device. When you enable private iCloud
sync with a subscription, CloudKit can synchronize that library, including
attached photos, through your iCloud account. Apple stores and processes synced
data under its terms and privacy policy. Stally's developer does not operate a
separate account or content server for your library.

Stally uses the synced content only to provide app functionality. It does not
provide your collection content to advertising SDKs or a developer-operated
analytics service. The app stores your sync selection and the last resolved
subscription state on this device. Sync changes apply on the next app launch;
changing these settings does not issue deletion requests for your collection.

## On-Device Input Assistance

When you request Input Assistance on a supported device, Apple's on-device
Foundation Models process the text you type or paste to suggest an Item name,
note, and link. This operation does not read your saved collection or fetch
links in the input. Stally does not send this text to a developer-operated or
external AI service, save a transcript, or include the input in application
logs.

You review suggestions before applying them to empty fields in the Item form.
Generating or applying a suggestion does not save an Item; you can edit the
fields before choosing Save. Prepare Item from Text in Shortcuts uses the same
on-device processing and returns text without saving an Item. Content you
choose to save follows the device-storage and optional iCloud behavior above.

## Export and Shared Links

Stally lets you export records for use in other apps, including AI tools you
choose, or for transfer to another device. You choose where a file is saved or
shared and are responsible for copies outside the app. Providers you choose
handle the exported data under their own terms and privacy policies. A package
can contain saved photos with their embedded metadata. Standalone records JSON
includes captions and other records but does not contain image files.

For import into Stally, use the file promptly after export. Future versions may
not support older files. This does not change the contents of files you have
already exported or prevent their use in other compatible tools.

Shared links identify a Stally destination or item identifier. They do not
upload the item name, note, photo, or history to a Stally-operated server.

## Purchases

Apple processes subscriptions through StoreKit. Stally receives the purchase
status needed to provide subscription benefits, but it does not receive or
store your payment card details.

## Advertising Components

This release does not include advertising SDKs, display ads or ask for
permission to track you across other companies' apps and websites. If
production advertising is enabled in a future release, this policy and the
App Store privacy disclosures will be updated before that release.

## Retention and Deletion

Your local library remains on your device until you delete items or remove the
app and its data. When iCloud sync is available, deletions can synchronize
through CloudKit. You can manage Stally's iCloud data through Apple's iCloud
settings. Exported files remain wherever you chose to save them until you delete
them there.

Archive keeps an item and its information while hiding it from Library. It does
not delete data or stop elapsed time.

## Update Checks, Website, and Support

At startup and when returning to the foreground, Stally can retrieve update
requirements from a small configuration file hosted on
`raw.githubusercontent.com` and check Apple's App Store for the availability of
a required version. These
requests identify the app and may include the App Store country; they do not
include Item names, notes, photos, Marks, periods, or input-assistance text.
GitHub and Apple may receive standard network request information, such as an
IP address, under their respective privacy policies.

GitHub Pages hosts the Stally website and this policy. GitHub processes website
requests under the
[GitHub General Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

For support, contact [@muhiro_12 on X](https://x.com/muhiro_12). X handles
information you submit under its own [Privacy Policy](https://x.com/en/privacy).
Do not include exported collection files, private photos, account details, or
other personal information in a public post.

## Your Choices

You can:

- add, change, or remove item photos;
- delete individual items and their history;
- export a copy of your library; and
- review a file before importing selected records.

## Security

Stally uses Apple's platform storage and CloudKit technologies and limits
the size of saved photos. Saved photos can contain embedded metadata. No method
of electronic storage is guaranteed to be completely secure, so keep exported
files in a location you trust.

## Changes to This Policy

This policy may be updated when Stally's data practices change. The effective
date at the top of this page will be revised when an update is published.
